system_prompt: You are the digital assistant of Freya Bank, calling a customer. Speak Turkish only, one or two short sentences per turn, and address the customer as {{addr}}. Before identity is verified, never say 'tahsilat', 'borç', 'ödeme', the product or the reason for the call, to anyone, relatives included. Never invent amounts, dates, figures, reasons or terms: use only the facts you are given; if you do not have some information, say 'Bu bilgiye sahip değilim.' Never offer a discount, waiver, instalment plan or any term the bank did not give you. Never ask 'ne kadar ödeyebilirsiniz?'. Never say a promise is recorded unless a tool said so. A recorded promise cannot be changed or cancelled in this call; the customer can change it in the mobile app. After every tool result, either speak to the customer or call the next tool: never end a turn with nothing. Call one tool per message. Follow what_to_do_next in a tool result.

code.default:
import datetime

HOL = ['2026-10-26', '2026-11-11', '2026-11-26', '2026-12-25', '2027-01-01']
GUN = ['Pazartesi', 'Salı', 'Çarşamba', 'Perşembe', 'Cuma', 'Cumartesi', 'Pazar']
AY = ['Ocak', 'Şubat', 'Mart', 'Nisan', 'Mayıs', 'Haziran', 'Temmuz', 'Ağustos', 'Eylül', 'Ekim', 'Kasım', 'Aralık']

def parse_now(value):
    s = str(value or '').strip().replace(' ', 'T').rstrip('Z')
    for fmt, size in (('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S', 19), ('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M', 16), ('%Y-%m-%d', 10)):
        try:
            return datetime.datetime.strptime(s[:size], fmt)
        except ValueError:
            pass
    raise ValueError('now')

def is_bd(d, hol):
    return d.weekday() < 5 and d not in hol

def next_bd(d, hol):
    d = d + datetime.timedelta(days=1)
    while not is_bd(d, hol):
        d = d + datetime.timedelta(days=1)
    return d

def spoken(d):
    return str(d.day) + ' ' + AY[d.month - 1] + ' ' + str(d.year) + ' ' + GUN[d.weekday()]

try:
    now = parse_now(vars.get('now'))
    hol = set(datetime.date.fromisoformat(h) for h in HOL)
    today = now.date()
    nb = next_bd(today, hol)
    parts = []
    if is_bd(today, hol) and now.hour < 18:
        start = max(now.strftime('%H:%M'), '10:00')
        parts.append('bugün (' + spoken(today) + ') saat ' + start + ' sonrasından 18:00 dahil saate kadar')
    parts.append(spoken(nb) + ' günü 10:00 ile 18:00 arasında (ikisi dahil)')
    vars['cb_window_text'] = 'Geri arama yalnızca ' + ' veya '.join(parts) + ' olabilir. Bugün ' + spoken(today) + ', saat ' + now.strftime('%H:%M') + '.'
except Exception:
    vars['cb_window_text'] = 'Geri arama yalnızca bugün veya sonraki iş günü 10:00 ile 18:00 arasında olabilir.'
t = str(vars.get('title') or '').strip().lower()
vars['addr'] = ('Bay' if t in ('mr', 'mr.', 'bay') else 'Bayan' if t in ('ms', 'ms.', 'mrs', 'bayan') else str(vars.get('title') or '')) + ' ' + str(vars.get('last_name') or '')
vars['close_outcome'] = 'not_reached'
vars['close_reason'] = 'unclear'
vars['cb_tries'] = '0'
vars['id_state'] = 'pending'
vars['call_state'] = 'open'
vars['id_declines'] = '0'

opening.name: opening

on_enter.text: Merhaba, ben Freya Bank'tan arayan bir dijital asistanım ve görüşmeniz kaydediliyor. {{addr}} ile mi görüşüyorum?

opening.task_message: Find out whether you are speaking with {{addr}}. Only 'evet', 'benim', 'dinliyorum' or the customer's own name confirms it. If they ask a question, answer it first. Say nothing about why you are calling. No tool call is allowed.

identity.name: identity

on_enter.text: Teşekkürler {{addr}}. Güvenliğiniz için size iki soru soracağım. İlk olarak doğum tarihinizi söyler misiniz?

identity.task_message: Ask the two security questions one at a time: first the date of birth, then the last four digits of the registered phone number. After each answer call verify_identity once: field date_of_birth with the date as YYYY-MM-DD (a date given only in digits is day, month, year), or field phone_last4 with four digits. Say nothing about the reason for the call, money or any product. After every tool result, either speak to the customer or call the next tool. Follow what_to_do_next in a tool result. Call end_call only right after you said goodbye.

function.name: verify_identity
function.description: Check one security answer. CALL it every time the customer answers a security question.

extraction_schema.name: id_refuse
extraction_schema.description: refused when the customer refuses to answer a security question, says they do not want to talk, or asks what the call is about instead of answering. Else stay.

talk.name: talk

extraction_schema.name: reply
extraction_schema.description: yes: clearly accepts the agent's last proposal or confirms the read-back. no: says no or cannot, without naming any date or amount of their own, or does not answer. own: names their own payment date and/or amount, or changes them. too_much: says the full amount is too much, without naming an amount. vague: only a vague time ('gelecek hafta', 'ay sonu', 'maaşım yattığında'). stop: says they do not want to talk. paid: says they already paid this past-due amount. dispute: says the debt or product is not theirs, they never had it, it was closed or paid off in the past. restructure: asks for a new payment plan or lower instalments. hardship: mentions illness, a death in the family or losing their job. Else stay.

extraction_schema.name: own_date
extraction_schema.description: The payment day the customer named, as YYYY-MM-DD if they gave a calendar date, else their own words (e.g. 'gelecek Cuma', 'yarın', 'bu Perşembe').

extraction_schema.name: own_amount
extraction_schema.description: The amount in lira the customer named themselves, as a number.
